## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Defensive/Healthcare names are among the top performers (EL, MRK, JNJ, PFE ABOVE TREND) and both Financials (1W: -2.01%) and Industrials (1W: -2.78%) are negative; Leadership: Mixed (Top 5 spread across 3 sectors).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND. Energy strong: EOG (1W: +7.32% | 1M: +5.20%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +12.95%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing strength: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, TGT (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +23.97%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -8.05% | 1M: -19.39%) BELOW TREND. Industrials under pressure: LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND. Financials mixed but soft 1W: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION while sector 1W is negative.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, NEM (1W: +11.74% | 1M: +38.91%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +8.10% | 1M: +13.69%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Mixed (3 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ETN (1W: -7.16% | 1M: +1.23%) CORRECTION, LMT (1W: -7.41% | 1M: -0.88%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -7.54% | 1M: +2.38%) CORRECTION, TJX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, HON (1W: -7.72% | 1M: -12.07%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Consumer Discretionary names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: EL (1W: +18.40%), FCX (1W: +15.30%), MRK (1W: +12.30%). Note MAJOR divergence among megacaps (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN showing 1W weakness vs 1M strength) — tactical caution, watch for trend break in large-cap leadership.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech mixed to soft: AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: -2.27% | 1M: +26.88%) CORRECTION, NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) CORRECTION, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND, INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — sector 1W: -1.85% (24 stocks), watch for further leadership erosion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials showing short-term weakness: JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) CORRECTION while V (1W: +1.89% | 1M: +5.73%) ABOVE TREND and MA (1W: +1.99% | 1M: +9.49%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W: -2.01% (20 stocks) — overall tone mixed but leaning defensive given 1W roll-off.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is a clear defensive leader: MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +3.80% | 1M: +4.23%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +6.38% | 1M: +6.01%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND — sector 1W: +3.76% (17 stocks) and showing confirmation of RISK-OFF defensive demand.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor defensive exposure into Healthcare and Consumer Staples (MRK, EL, JNJ, PFE) and selectively maintain exposure to Materials/Energy strength (FCX, NEM, XOM) while reducing exposure to high-beta Tech names showing 1W weakness (NVDA, INTC, AMD). Monitor the megacap divergence (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN) for confirmation before shifting core allocations.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.30% | 1M: +16.91%) ABOVE TREND, FCX (1W: +15.30% | 1M: +20.72%) ABOVE TREND — catalysts and momentum to confirm. BEARISH: INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND, META (1W: -6.77% | 1M: -9.27%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: -9.82% | 1M: -4.11%) BELOW TREND — at risk on sentiment and earnings/guide sensitivity.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W +3.76%, 17 stocks) and Materials (1W +1.12%, 11 stocks) for defensive/commodity-led strength. BEARISH: Technology (1W -1.85%, 24 stocks) and Industrials (1W -2.78%, 15 stocks) where 1W weakness could extend.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch NVDA (1W: -4.64% | 1M: +2.85%) — needs reclaim of recent 1W losses for CORRECTION to reverse; AAPL (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -3.74%) must hold the 1W gain to sustain RECOVERY; JPM (1W: -3.10% | 1M: +0.48%) needs follow-through above the monthly pivot to validate a reversal; EL (1W: +18.40% | 1M: +27.55%) watch for continuation above recent breakout levels to confirm sustained ABOVE TREND leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
HD (+70): Headline-driven; HD (1W: -0.96% | 1M: +3.36%) TREND EXHAUSTION → labeled CORRECTION; price shows mild pullback despite bullish news, watch for confirmation. (Note: HD appears in data and sentiment is confirming potential accumulation if price stabilizes.)

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
INTC (-55): Headline severe; INTC (1W: -12.13% | 1M: -10.14%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirms distribution. TJX (-50): TJX (1W: -7.61% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned. TGT (-45): TGT (1W: +7.09% | 1M: +23.97%) ABOVE TREND — bearish headlines diverge from strong price action, monitor for distribution vs continued strength. CVX (-45): CVX (1W: +3.53% | 1M: +6.50%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines but price holding, watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Defensive/Value tilt. MRK, EL, FCX, NEM ABOVE TREND and showing relative strength while Tech megacaps (MSFT, NVDA, AMZN) exhibit short-term weakness/CORRECTION risk. Key risk is the megacap divergence and headline-driven pressure on chips and select cyclicals (INTC, META, TJX) — monitor sentiment-confirmation before rotating aggressively.
